text:
Leipzig’s median asking rent sits at 10.0 €/m², up 1.5 % year‑on‑year and 30.7 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 2.2 % and an average of 31 days on market; 26 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is pressured: a 60 m² apartment costs about 600 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 15.2 %. Asking rents are roughly 55 % above the 2022 census rent of 6.44 €/m², reflecting strong demand amid 5.7 % population growth.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.67 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 10.33‑10.99 €/m², implying a 6.7 % increase.
